item.description:
SimKit 1.8.1

New for coding agents (MCP)

  • Mock folders: agents can put mocks in folders, rename folders and set their order with organize_mocks, the user's mocks included. Nothing but the folder changes, and the reply says which mocks now win a match.
  • Mocks from real traffic: set_mock can start from a captured request.
  • App state and screen: get_app_state tells whether an app is running or how it crashed; get_screen_elements reads the screen's elements through the SDK; get_permissions reads an app's permissions.
  • Simulator: set_time_zone, restart_simulator, slow animations, a custom status bar (time, battery, bars, carrier), GPX routes, and send_memory_warning and get_clipboard on simulators.
  • Network: save_contract and delete_contract, set_capture_paused, and custom download and upload speeds in set_network_conditions.
  • Debugging: relaunch_app can wait for a debugger and returns the process id.

SimKit now has 100 tools for agents.

Fixes

  • Deleting a saved notification, deep link, UserDefaults key, keychain item or cookie now asks first.
  • Tabs that need a simulator say so instead of acting on none.
  • Panel switches keep their colour when SimKit isn't the active app, and cut-off text now wraps.
  • Icon-only buttons have names for VoiceOver and tooltips.

SimKit 1.8

New

  • Coding agents (MCP): Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients can read captured requests, set mocks and drive the simulator through 91 tools. Turn it on in the Agents tab.
  • Real devices: pair an iPhone or iPad by a 6-digit code and see its traffic over Wi-Fi, encrypted.
  • Performance tab: frame rate, memory, CPU and main-thread hangs, with the code each hang was in.
  • Network: pause capture, Edit & Resend, request origin, token history and Expire Token, bug reports, and insights for refresh storms and duplicate requests.
  • Mocks: fill a mock from a captured response, Would Match preview, Network Weather and scenario files.
  • Monitor without the SDK: SimKit can start a simulator app with the SDK loaded into it.
  • Debug: Snapshots that save and restore an app's data, Steps, the app's console and more.
  • Also: an accessibility audit, design diff, a map in Location, ⌘K, and Settings › General › Updates.

Real devices, Performance and request origin need SimKit SDK 1.9.

SimKit 1.7

New

  • Graphite, a new dark design for the panel and the Network Monitor.
  • Request list: query filters (status:>=400 host:api slow:>300ms), p50/p95 in the status bar, and Copy as cURL, fetch, HTTPie or Swift.
  • Auth tab: decodes JWTs, shows expiry and which requests use the token. Copied requests hide secrets.
  • Generate Model: turns a JSON response into Swift Codable types.
  • Location: paste coordinates or a Maps link, and play GPX routes at walking, biking or driving speed.
  • Debug tab: Shake (⌃⌥⌘Z) and Memory Warning, which Xcode 27's Device Hub no longer offers.
  • Window mode: the panel's tabs in a regular window.
  • SimKit now opens at login. Turn it off in Settings › General.

Fixed

  • Xcode 27 and iOS 27: Device Hub is recognized, memory warnings reach apps again, and screenshots and recordings save correctly.
  • Apply & Relaunch now really relaunches the app in the new language and time zone.
  • Location permission, UserDefaults loading, contract drift and the deep link app lookup work again.
  • The Mocked badge no longer wraps, and the request lists are tidier.
  • Many smaller fixes across the panel.
